title: Jump Game
keyIdea: The reachable indexes always form a prefix 0..maxReach. Walk left to right: if i > maxReach you are stuck (false); otherwise maxReach = max(maxReach, i + nums[i]). Reaching the end of the loop means the last index is reachable.

approaches.name: Greedy farthest reach
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). maxReach starts at 0; return false if i > maxReach; else extend it.

quiz.q: Why does one number (maxReach) describe everything reachable?
options: If you can reach index r, you can reach every index before it too

quiz.q: When does the greedy return false?
options: When i > maxReach: no earlier position can jump to i

steps: nums[i] is the maximum jump length? Can it be 0?
Trace [3,2,1,0,4]: where do you get stuck?
Brute force: DFS/DP over every jump. Cost?
"Can I reach the end?" → what single value to track?
Plan the loop and the stuck check.
